parts.text: Reframe this as a standard collection portrait: zoom out so the whole tentacle-faced creature is smaller and centred in the frame, head and shoulders plus upper body fully visible with clear space around the head, both bat wings fully inside the frame, body turned about 45 degrees to the right. Keep the same character design, clay finish, stormy sea, moon and the small hooded cultists in the background. Replace the glowing green pentagram on the ground with a plain glowing green ring with no star or symbol. No text.
